gloss: moment of parting; time of farewell; parting

definitions.gloss: moment of parting; time of farewell; the instant of separation
definitions.explanation: The specific moment or time when people part ways or say goodbye. Often refers to the brief period just before or during separation.

examples.english: At the moment of parting, I said 'Let's meet again.'
Tears came at the moment of parting.

examples.japanese: {別|わか}れ{際|ぎわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧なこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}え→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I forgot to tell them something important at the time of parting.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{別|わか}れ→別れ：03788_wakare⟧ (parting, from ⟦{別|わか}れる→別れる：01113_wakareru⟧) + {際|ぎわ} (edge, moment, brink)

The suffix ～{際|ぎわ} indicates a critical moment or boundary:
- ⟦{土壇場|どたんば}→土壇場：10555_dotanba⟧/{際|ぎわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{際|ぎわ} - the last moment
- ⟦{瀬戸|せと}{際|ぎわ}→瀬戸際：10554_setogiwa⟧ - critical moment
- {寝|ね}{際|ぎわ} - just before sleeping

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {別|わか}れ{際|ぎわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ - at the moment of parting
- {別|わか}れ{際|ぎわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun - parting ~

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {別|わか}れ{際|ぎわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ - to say at parting
- {別|わか}れ{際|ぎわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧ - parting greetings
- {別|わか}れ{際|ぎわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧ - parting words
- {別|わか}れ{際|ぎわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧ - to wave at parting

USAGE:
Emotionally significant moment. Often appears in:
- Romantic contexts
- Family separations
- Farewells to colleagues/friends
- Dramatic/literary contexts

SIMILAR ～{際|ぎわ} COMPOUNDS:
- {帰|かえ}り{際|ぎわ} - just as leaving
- {出|で}{際|ぎわ} - just as going out
- {寝|ね}{際|ぎわ} - just before sleeping
- {死|し}に{際|ぎわ} - on the verge of death

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{別|わか}れ→別れる：01113_wakareru⟧{時|どき} - time of parting
- {告別|こくべつ} - farewell (formal)
- ⟦{惜別|せきべつ}→惜別：21290_sekibetsu⟧ - reluctant parting (literary)

REGISTER:
Neutral. Natural in both spoken and written Japanese.
